title: Profile Generator IR (intermediate representation)
description: The stable contract between the Python extraction stage and the TypeScript assembly stage. The extractor parses ServiceNow KB runbook HTML into this; the assembler turns it into a v2 client profile. Keep this schema and assemble/src/ir.ts in lockstep.

leaf.description: Last path segment — the per-client name to match on.

path.description: Full client path minus TOP/, may be nested (CVP/<practice>).

family.description: Franchise family, if the client is a practice under one.

primaryDomain.description: Inferred primary domain, if found in the runbook.

actions.description: Which lifecycle actions had a latest KB for this client.

backboneHint.description: Inferred identity backbone (Domain/AD-Sync -> ad-synced; G-Suite -> google; Entra-only -> entra). The assembler treats it as a default to be reviewed.

detected.description: One entry per (system, action) the extractor recognised and mapped to a catalog key.

section.description: The raw section header the signal came from.

confidence.description: Extractor's confidence this section really means this system.

mode.description: Suggested execution mode (defaults from the catalog).

signals.description: Structured hints pulled from the section body: licenses[], groups[], ou, usernamePattern, password, requiresApproval, captureEvidence, schedule, guardrails. Free-form; the assembler maps known keys into the profile.

instructions.description: The runbook step text for this section (clipped) — surfaced to reviewers.

unmodeled.description: Sections detected in the runbook that do NOT map to a catalog system key — the team's backlog of extractors to write next.

guess.description: Best guess at what system/vendor this is, if recognisable (e.g. 'Duo (MFA)', 'Box', 'Salesforce').

instructions.description: The runbook step text for this section (clipped) — surfaced to reviewers.

warnings.description: Per-client extraction warnings (placeholder text seen, missing primary domain, ambiguous backbone, etc.).
